h1: Apartment Interior Design, Custom Furniture & Turnkey Renovation in Varna, 60 m²

blocks.text: Apartment Interior Design, Custom Furniture & Turnkey Renovation in Varna, 60 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN developed and completed a comprehensive project for a 60 m² apartment in Varna, Bulgaria. The project combined interior design, technical documentation, custom-made furniture and comprehensive turnkey renovation.

The layout and interior solutions include the living room, bedroom, kitchen with integrated appliances, walk-in wardrobes, entrance hall, bathroom and functional storage systems. Particular attention was given to ergonomics, efficient use of space and creating a comfortable environment for everyday living.

Custom-made furniture was designed and manufactured specifically for the apartment, including the kitchen, built-in wardrobes, walk-in closets, shelving and storage systems. The furniture was developed together with the interior concept, allowing it to be precisely integrated into the architecture and making efficient use of every square metre.

Before implementation, a detailed estimate was prepared covering construction and finishing works, materials, custom furniture, household appliances, sanitary equipment, lighting and other elements specified in the project. Following the design stage, a comprehensive turnkey apartment renovation in Varna was completed in accordance with the developed technical documentation.

The project also included photorealistic 3D visualizations, allowing the future interior, materials, furniture and lighting solutions to be evaluated before implementation. The completed result is presented through photographs of the finished apartment and its custom-made furniture.

This 60 m² apartment project demonstrates DUMSKAYA DESIGN’s comprehensive approach — from interior design and technical documentation to custom furniture production and complete interior implementation.
